_comment: Per-unit overrides on top of data/bsdata/parsed.json. Each entry can partially override any field (health, damage, hit_probability, ap, save, name, enabled, notes). Standalone entries listed here that don't exist in parsed.json become fully hand-rolled units; they must specify all required fields.

necrons_necron_warriors.notes: 10e Necron Warriors carry the Their Number Is Legion rule — they have OC equal to a normal infantryman PLUS hold objectives even after leaving them. Sourced from wahapedia.ru Necrons datasheet. | Range left at mapper-selected 12" (Gauss Reaper) — Gauss Flayer 24" is the alternate wargear, both valid; not a mapper bug.

genestealer_cults_acolyte_hybrids_with_h.notes: 10e GSC Acolyte Hybrids have Cult Ambush which keeps objective control after the unit leaves. Sourced from wahapedia.ru Genestealer Cults datasheet.

genestealer_cults_acolyte_hybrids_with_a.notes: 10e GSC Acolyte Hybrids have Cult Ambush which keeps objective control after the unit leaves. Sourced from wahapedia.ru Genestealer Cults datasheet.

death_guard_plague_marines.notes: Death Guard army rule Disgustingly Resilient grants every DEATH GUARD model FNP 5+. The rule is codex-level and is not encoded on individual BSData datasheets, so the mapper cannot see it — override here. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/death-guard/ (Army Rule: Disgustingly Resilient). | sweg_balance_mc up 22.5 -> 24.75 pts/model | Plague Marine boltgun range 24" confirmed correct (no change). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/death-guard/#Plague-Marines

chaos_space_marines_plague_marines.notes: Cross-codex BSData entry for Plague Marines; canonical datasheet lives in the Death Guard codex and carries Disgustingly Resilient (FNP 5+). Pricing and stats are identical to death_guard_plague_marines. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/death-guard/#Plague-Marines.

aeldari_craftworlds_wraithguard.notes: Wraithguard have a 4+ invulnerable save listed on their datasheet, but BSData does not encode it (no Invulnerable-Save infoLink in the unit entry). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/aeldari/#Wraithguard. | sweg_balance_mc up 218.68 -> 240.55 pts/model

aeldari_craftworlds_wraithblades.notes: Wraithblades have a 4+ invulnerable save listed on their datasheet, but BSData does not encode it. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/aeldari/#Wraithblades.

t_au_empire_crisis_sunforge_battlesuits.notes: sweg_balance_mc down 157.74 -> 141.97 pts/model | Invuln 4+ already picked up from BSData mapper (Sunforge is the only Crisis variant whose entry encodes the Invulnerable-Save infoLink — see Fireknife/Starscythe overrides for the missing-sibling story). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Crisis-Battlesuits

t_au_empire_crisis_fireknife_battlesuits.notes: sweg_balance_mc down 126.83 -> 114.15 pts/model | iter20: 4++ Battlesuit Shield Generator. Every Crisis Battlesuit datasheet variant (Fireknife / Starscythe / Sunforge) carries the same Battlesuit Shield Generator equipment granting a 4+ invulnerable save. BSData v10.6.0 only encodes the Invulnerable-Save infoLink on the Sunforge entry (verified by walking sharedSelectionEntries — Fireknife and Starscythe sibling entries are missing the infoLink that Sunforge has). This is a BSData per-variant encoding gap, not a mapper logic bug — the mapper correctly walks the tree but the data isn't there to find. Override here. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Crisis-Battlesuits (datasheet lists Invulnerable Save 4+ for every Crisis variant).

t_au_empire_crisis_starscythe_battlesuit.notes: iter20: 4++ Battlesuit Shield Generator. Companion fix to Fireknife — same BSData per-variant encoding gap; Sunforge has the Invulnerable-Save infoLink, Starscythe doesn't, but per Wahapedia all three Crisis variants share the Battlesuit Shield Generator (4++) equipment. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Crisis-Battlesuits

t_au_empire_commander_in_enforcer_battle.notes: iter20: 4++ Battlesuit Shield Generator. Tau Commanders all carry the Battlesuit Shield Generator (4+ invulnerable save) per their datasheet wargear; BSData v10.6.0 does not encode the Invulnerable-Save infoLink on the Commander selectionEntry. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Commander-in-Enforcer-Battlesuit

t_au_empire_commander_in_coldstar_battle.notes: iter20: 4++ Battlesuit Shield Generator. Same gear as the Enforcer Commander — Coldstar Battlesuit datasheet lists Invulnerable Save 4+ from the Battlesuit Shield Generator. BSData entry omits the infoLink. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Commander-in-Coldstar-Battlesuit

t_au_empire_riptide_battlesuit.notes: Riptide ships on an 80mm round. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/tau-empire/#Riptide-Battlesuit (Base size). points_override removed 2026-05-15 — was 1180.58 from sweg_balance_mc (Lanchester-tainted), real GW is 180 pts/model; let base catalogue price it.

t_au_empire_pathfinder_team.notes: Pathfinder Team carries Markerlights (Pulse Carbine + Markerlight wargear). Add MARKERLIGHT keyword so the simulator's _run_markerlight_phase can spot Guided enemies. BSData does not encode the Markerlight keyword as a unit-level tag — it lives on the weapon entry — so we surface it here. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Pathfinder-Team and the army-rule https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Markerlights

t_au_empire_stealth_battlesuits.notes: Stealth Battlesuits — the squad shas'ui can take a Homing Beacon, and one model in the unit can take a Markerlight (Burst Cannon swap). Add MARKERLIGHT keyword so the simulator's _run_markerlight_phase counts the squad as a marker carrier. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Stealth-Battlesuits and the army-rule https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Markerlights

t_au_empire_tetras_legends.notes: Tetra Scout Speeders — twin Markerlight platform. Legends datasheet retains the MARKERLIGHT keyword. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Tetras and the army-rule https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Markerlights

thousand_sons_rubric_marines.notes: sweg_balance_mc down 66.6 -> 59.94 pts/model | Rubric Marines: 5++ invulnerable save. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/#Rubric-Marines | Inferno Boltgun (primary wargear) range corrected to 24" per Wahapedia datasheet (mapper basket-average underrated as 12" by mixing in Warpflamer). | iter14: added RUBRICAE unit keyword so the simulator.all_is_dust gate (Rubricae Phalanx detachment rule, '+1 to armour save vs unmodified Damage 1 attacks on RUBRICAE models') can fire only on the canonically-correct subset. BSData parser does not extract sub-faction unit keywords. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/Rubric-Marines.html (Keywords: INFANTRY, BATTLELINE, CHAOS, TZEENTCH, RUBRICAE, RUBRIC MARINES).

thousand_sons_scarab_occult_terminators.notes: sweg_balance_mc down 109.98 -> 98.98 pts/model | Scarab Occult Terminators: 4++ invulnerable save. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/#Scarab-Occult-Terminators | iter14: added RUBRICAE + TERMINATOR unit keywords; RUBRICAE feeds simulator.all_is_dust (Rubricae Phalanx +1 save vs D1) and the unit's datasheet Rites of Coalescence (-1 to wound while a PSYKER is present) is read via the PSYKER keyword in simulator.rites_of_coalescence. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/Scarab-Occult-Terminators.html (Keywords: INFANTRY, TERMINATOR, CHAOS, TZEENTCH, RUBRICAE, SCARAB OCCULT).

thousand_sons_sorcerer.notes: Sorcerer: 5++ invulnerable save. BSData does not encode the Invulnerable-Save infoLink. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/Sorcerer.html (Save 3+ / Invulnerable Save 5+ / T4 / W4).

thousand_sons_sorcerer_in_terminator_arm.notes: Sorcerer in Terminator Armour: 4++ invulnerable save. BSData does not encode the Invulnerable-Save infoLink. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/Sorcerer-In-Terminator-Armour.html (Save 2+ / Invulnerable Save 4+ / T5 / W5).

thousand_sons_pink_horrors.notes: Pink Horrors: 4++ invulnerable save (Tzeentch Daemon). BSData does not encode the Invulnerable-Save infoLink for Daemon datasheets. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/Pink-Horrors.html (Save 7+ / Invulnerable Save 4+ / T3 / W1).

thousand_sons_blue_horrors.notes: Blue Horrors: 4++ invulnerable save (Tzeentch Daemon). BSData does not encode the Invulnerable-Save infoLink. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/Blue-Horrors.html (Save 7+ / Invulnerable Save 4+ / T3 / W1).

thousand_sons_flamers.notes: Flamers: 4++ invulnerable save (Tzeentch Daemon). BSData does not encode the Invulnerable-Save infoLink. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/Flamers.html (Save 7+ / Invulnerable Save 4+ / T4 / W3).

thousand_sons_screamers.notes: Screamers: 4++ invulnerable save (Tzeentch Daemon). BSData does not encode the Invulnerable-Save infoLink. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/Screamers.html (Save 6+ / Invulnerable Save 4+ / T4 / W3).

thousand_sons_magnus_the_red.notes: Magnus the Red: 4++ invulnerable save. BSData does not encode the Invulnerable-Save infoLink. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/#Magnus-the-Red

thousand_sons_exalted_sorcerer_on_disc_o.notes: Exalted Sorcerer on Disc of Tzeentch: 5++ invulnerable save. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/#Exalted-Sorcerer-on-Disc-of-Tzeentch

thousand_sons_daemon_prince_of_tzeentch.notes: Daemon Prince of Tzeentch: 4++ invulnerable save. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/#Daemon-Prince-of-Tzeentch

thousand_sons_lord_of_change.notes: Lord of Change: 4++ invulnerable save. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/#Lord-of-Change

Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/space-marines/#Intercessor-Squad

death_guard_deathshroud_terminators.notes: sweg_balance_mc up 55.0 -> 60.5 pts/model | iter20: 4++ Cataphractii-pattern Terminator armour. Deathshroud carry the standard 4+ invulnerable save common to all 10e Terminator chassis. BSData v10.6.0 omits the Invulnerable-Save infoLink on this entry (verified — entry has type=unit, no Invulnerable Save infoLink in tree); broader pattern affects every Chaos Terminator squad (Blightlord, Scarab Occult, Deathshroud, generic Chaos Terminators). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/death-guard/#Deathshroud-Terminators (datasheet lists Invulnerable Save 4+).

death_guard_blightlord_terminators.notes: iter20: 4++ Cataphractii-pattern Terminator armour, same as Deathshroud. BSData v10.6.0 omits the Invulnerable-Save infoLink on the Blightlord entry. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/death-guard/#Blightlord-Terminators (datasheet lists Invulnerable Save 4+).

necrons_lychguard.notes: iter20: 4++ Dispersion Shield. Necron Lychguard carry a Dispersion Shield (or Hyperphase Sword) and the datasheet grants every model in the unit a 4+ invulnerable save regardless of loadout. BSData v10.6.0 omits the Invulnerable-Save infoLink on the Lychguard entry (verified — both unit-type and model-type entries have no Invulnerable Save infoLink anywhere in their walks). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/necrons/#Lychguard (datasheet lists Invulnerable Save 4+).

adeptus_custodes_caladius_grav_tank.notes: sweg_balance_mc up 215.0 -> 236.5 pts/model | iter8 mobility audit: M=12" per Wahapedia datasheet (BSData parser does not emit numeric M, defaulted to 6"). VEHICLE+FLY (hover) already on the keyword list. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/#Caladius-Grav-tank

adeptus_custodes_allarus_custodians.notes: sweg_balance_mc up 65.0 -> 71.5 pts/model | iter8 mobility audit: M=5" per Wahapedia datasheet (Terminator armour). Deep Strike already flagged True on the BSData entry. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/#Allarus-Custodian-Squad

adeptus_custodes_vertus_praetors.notes: iter8 mobility audit: M=14" per Wahapedia datasheet (jetbike). MOUNTED+FLY keywords already set on the BSData entry; the M value is the missing piece that was capping the simulator's reach at the universal 6" default. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/#Vertus-Praetors

adeptus_custodes_prosecutors.notes: iter8 mobility audit: M=7" per Wahapedia datasheet (Sisters of Silence light infantry — faster than power-armoured marines). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/#Prosecutors

leagues_of_votann_hearthkyn_warriors.notes: sweg_balance_mc down 100.0 -> 90.0 pts/model | Ion Blaster (mapper-selected primary, x9 on loadout) range corrected to 18" per Wahapedia datasheet (mapper basket-average underrated as 12" by mixing in Autoch-pattern Bolt Pistol 12"). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/leagues-of-votann/#Hearthkyn-Warriors

t_au_empire_strike_team.notes: Pulse Rifle (primary wargear) range corrected to 30" per Wahapedia datasheet (mapper basket-average underrated as 12" by mixing in Pulse Carbine 18" / Pulse Pistol 12"). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/tau-empire/#Strike-Team | iter16: add MARKERLIGHT keyword. 10e Strike Team datasheet keyword line is INFANTRY, BATTLELINE, MARKERLIGHT, FIRE WARRIOR, STRIKE TEAM (every Strike Team has Markerlight; Shas'ui can take one as standard wargear). BSData encodes Markerlight on the weapon row only. Restores Mont'ka Markerlight->Guided->[LETHAL HITS] chain at MSU scale. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/Strike-Team.html (keyword line).

chaos_space_marines_rubric_marines.notes: Cross-codex BSData entry for Rubric Marines; canonical datasheet lives in the Thousand Sons codex. Inferno Boltgun (primary wargear) range corrected to 24" per Wahapedia datasheet (mapper basket-average underrated as 12" by mixing in Warpflamer). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/thousand-sons/#Rubric-Marines

t_au_empire_breacher_team.notes: iter16: add MARKERLIGHT keyword. 10e Breacher Team datasheet keyword line is INFANTRY, BATTLELINE, GRENADES, MARKERLIGHT, FIRE WARRIOR, BREACHER TEAM (Shas'ui can take a Markerlight). BSData encodes Markerlight on the weapon row only. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/Breacher-Team.html (keyword line).

t_au_empire_sky_ray_gunship.notes: iter16: add MARKERLIGHT keyword. 10e Sky Ray Gunship datasheet keyword line is VEHICLE, FLY, MARKERLIGHT, SKY RAY GUNSHIP. The gunship is the army flying-Markerlight platform (carries Networked Markerlights). BSData encodes Markerlight on the weapon row only. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/Sky-Ray-Gunship.html (keyword line).
